mappings.basis: Unit 1 states that residents may enter the lantern lottery, the target's permission with the restricting population folded in. Unit 2 restates the same permission for the same actor and action, shortening 'lantern lottery' to 'lottery'; a reader takes it as the same assertion.

mapping_doubts.note: Unit 1 is narrower than the target: the 'Only residents' restriction is folded into the assertion text as the actor. Mapped direct under M3.
Unit 2 drops the modifier 'lantern' from the object; treated as the same object (the lottery in this source) rather than a different one. Close call but mapped direct.
